edits.edit_diff:
--- /linux/fs/ocfs2/dir.c
+++ /linux/fs/ocfs2/dir.c
@@ -812,5 +812,10 @@
-		ret = ocfs2_error(inode->i_sb,
-				  "Inode %lu has bad extent record (%u, %u, 0) in btree\n",
-				  inode->i_ino,
-				  le32_to_cpu(rec->e_cpos),
-				  ocfs2_rec_clusters(el, rec));
+		if (rec)
+			ret = ocfs2_error(inode->i_sb,
+					  "Inode %lu has bad extent record (%u, %u, 0) in btree\n",
+					  inode->i_ino,
+					  le32_to_cpu(rec->e_cpos),
+					  ocfs2_rec_clusters(el, rec));
+		else
+			ret = ocfs2_error(inode->i_sb,
+					  "Inode %lu has empty extent list in btree\n",
+					  inode->i_ino);
